//: Root tsconfig for the BACKEND track only (supabase/**). apps/web gets its own
tsconfig from Prince — Next.js generates one, and keeping the two separate
avoids a shared file that both of us would edit (Workflow.md §5).
strict + noImplicitAny satisfy rules.md §5.3. allowImportingTsExtensions is on
because the scripts are run directly by tsx and use explicit .ts specifiers,
which is what Node's own resolver wants for ESM.
//exclude: supabase/functions is excluded because Edge Functions target the Deno
runtime, not Node: they use the Deno global, URL imports, and Deno's own
type resolution. Typechecking them with this Node-oriented config would
produce noise, not signal. They are checked by `deno check` / at deploy time.
